pages.title: Finding Mithril
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 32 to 128. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 1 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 5.

pages.title: Working Mithril
pages.text: Smelt Mithril Ore or Mithril Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 1111 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 5.$(br)Mining efficiency: 9.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 5.5.$(br)Enchantability: 18.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.0.$(br)Enchantability: 20.

pages.title: Pickaxe: Multiply
pages.text: Breaking ore sometimes drops an additional ore along with the one mined. Effect chance scales with Fortune Enchantment

pages.title: Weapon: Magic Aspect
pages.text: Deals additional magic damage 1 second after the last entity was attacked

pages.title: Equipment: Arcane
pages.text: The more enchantments the item has the better it performs. (damage for weapons, mining speed for tools and more protection from armor)
